blockingIssues.problem: The title asserts that fixing cooling first will produce the greatest reduction in cracks. The source does not support a claim that prioritizing cooling will have the greatest benefit; it only reports that most cracks were first recorded at cooling and explicitly says the note does not rank intervention benefits.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: "Most cracks were first recorded at cooling"; "two batches already showed cracks after shaping"; "The note does not rank intervention benefits."
blockingIssues.constraint: Do not present a specific intervention or sequence (e.g., 'fix cooling first for the greatest reduction') as the preferred or most effective action when the source explicitly declines to rank intervention benefits or provide evidence of relative effectiveness.
